theorems.name: Submission.tangential_c1_deformation_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (X : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ U, X x ∈ tangentSpace N x) → ∃ φ : ℝ → Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ t) ∧ Bijective (φ t) ∧ (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ (φ t) x)) ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ tsupport X → φ t x = x) ∧ MapsTo (φ t) (N ∩ U) (N ∩ U)) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ → ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x - ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - t • fderiv ℝ X x‖ ≤ ε * |t|
